items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Then I worked across the street at the Raleigh Rye with my brother Ed on the piano

ctx.x: What was your very first job or even first band that you played with?

Alfred Lane. Alfred Lane. Alfred Lane. Called him Pansy Lane. I played with him before I played with Emmett. And then I worked with him a while playing prize fights around the street, you know, advertising rather. And we went to work at the old Pup Cafe on Ivorville Street and worked there a while. Then I worked across the street at the Raleigh Rye with my brother Ed on the piano and a boy by the name of Willie Rich on drums. Yeah. And I left there. And Leon... Charlie Cadillo took my place. All right. And then I…
Well, what part of town were you raised in and where were you... What part of town were you born in and all?
